summary: The RTCPeerConnection web API now surfaces SCTP errors (SCTP is the protocol that powers WebRTC data channels) so web apps can see when data channels fail, and RTCSctpTransport.maxChannels is being set so applications know how many data channels are supported. The sctp property on RTCPeerConnection is now populated when a remote offer arrives, and transport stats start with iceState set to "new" so stats consumers get a clear initial state. _These are API polish and correctness fixes for data channels and connection state._
